issues.title: Password Authentication Broken
issues.description: Function returns null for all inputs, users cannot authenticate with passwords
issues.impact: Users unable to login, system unusable
issues.verification: Function now validates inputs and includes proper error handling

issues.title: XSS Vulnerability in Query Parameters
issues.description: Query parameters stored raw without HTML entity escaping, vulnerable to XSS attacks
issues.impact: Session token theft, malware injection, credential harvesting

issues.title: SQL Injection Detection Unused
issues.description: detectSqlInjection() function exists but is never called anywhere in codebase
issues.impact: SQL injection attacks not detected or prevented
issues.example_attack: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = 'admin' OR '1'='1'

issues.title: Rate Limiter IP Fallback Bypass
issues.description: Missing IP header falls back to 'anonymous', all no-IP requests share same bucket
issues.impact: Denial of Service, legitimate users blocked by attackers sharing same bucket
issues.dos_scenario: 100 legitimate users, 1 attacker → attacker fills shared 'anonymous' bucket → all 100 users blocked

issues.title: Error Message Information Disclosure
issues.description: Whitelist approach easily bypassed, error details expose database schema and credentials
issues.impact: Database schema exposure, credential leakage, API key/token disclosure
issues.example: Error message: 'Invalid: UNIQUE constraint on users.email_unique_idx' exposes table/column names

issues.title: Type Casting Without Null Safety
issues.description: Type casting (as string) performed before null check, undefined cast becomes string 'undefined'
issues.impact: Invalid role value in JWT token, permission bypass possible

issues.title: atomicUpdate Callback Signature Breaking Change
issues.description: Return type changed from { updated, result } to direct return, breaks downstream code
issues.impact: Code expecting result object receives undefined, runtime errors

issues.title: Defense-in-Depth Layer Removed
issues.description: Second validation layer (path.basename check) removed, relying on single safeJoin defense
issues.impact: If safeJoin has bug, no fallback protection against path traversal

issues.title: Alert Level Case Mismatch
issues.description: ALERT_PREFIXES key changed to lowercase, but alert.level case not validated
issues.impact: Template literal produces '[undefined] message' if alert.level is uppercase

issues.title: Rate Limiter Key Fallback Breaking Change
issues.description: Fallback changed from 'unknown' to 'anonymous', breaks code checking for 'unknown'
issues.impact: Production code checking if (ip === 'unknown') will fail to catch no-IP case

issues.title: Crypto Weak Fallback Logging
issues.description: Math.random() fallback not logged in production, uses console.log instead of logger
issues.impact: Security incidents missed in production monitoring

issues.title: Concurrent Delete Test Coverage Removed
issues.description: Tests for concurrent delete operations removed and replaced with simpler tests
issues.impact: Regression risk for concurrent update/delete scenarios

issues.title: Test Framework Assertion Incompatibility
issues.description: Using Vitest toStartWith() but tests may run on Jest (incompatible)
issues.impact: Test failures on Jest runner, CI/CD pipeline issues

issues.title: UTF-8 BOM Encoding Issue
issues.description: File starts with UTF-8 BOM character, causes parser warnings
issues.impact: Encoding issues, potential import/parsing failures in strict configs

issues.title: Missing Function Exports
issues.description: Tests reference functions not in public API

issues.title: Rate Limiting Missing Advanced Features
issues.description: No token revocation, no adaptive limits, no endpoint-specific rate limit configs
issues.impact: Missing protection against advanced DoS patterns and token compromise scenarios

issues.title: Return Value Signature Migration Incomplete
issues.description: atomicUpdate return type changes not uniformly applied (see HIGH_002)
issues.impact: Inconsistent API usage patterns throughout codebase

tier_3_fixes.notes: Optional, can follow in next sprint

production_readiness_checklist.item: All 5 CRITICAL issues fixed and tested
All 5 HIGH issues fixed and tested
All MEDIUM issues resolved or documented

control_measures.name: Production Monitoring
alerts: Alert on 'anonymous' rate limit bucket usage
Alert on error message information disclosure

primary_causes.reason: Security functions implemented but not integrated into request flow, no enforcement
API contracts changed without migration path, type system not enforcing null checks
Test suite downsized without documenting removed coverage, framework compatibility issues
Refactoring incomplete, no validation of new patterns

final_verdict.deployment_approval: DO NOT DEPLOY UNTIL TIER 1 FIXES COMPLETE
